raw.rationale: Pazopanib is a multi-kinase angiogenesis inhibitor with primary activity against VEGFR, PDGFR, and KIT, so selective killing at 2.5 µM is unlikely across most lineages; modest selectivity might occur in renal cell carcinoma (not listed) or KIT/PDGFR-dependent sarcoma/GIST lineages, but among the listed lineages only bone (sarcoma) and possibly urinary_tract have any plausible dependency, while the rest are expected to be non-selective.
